rules.title: A placeholder ships as a tracked promise
rules.text: A `TODO`, `FIXME`, `XXX` or `HACK` on a path that ships is a promise with no owner: either finish it, or record it where the work is tracked, because an untracked note reads as a plan to the next reader.

judgement.question: Is this placeholder a promise nobody tracks, on a path that ships, rather than a note that names where the work is tracked?

criteria.true: it ships with no reference to where the work is tracked and no dated decision beside it
criteria.false: it points at the place the work is tracked, or the line is a document stating the convention itself
